name.ja: 1/72 VF-1 A/S バルキリー 一条輝機
name.en: 1/72 VF-1 A/S Valkyrie Ichijo Hikaru machine

description.ja: • 河森正治監督完全監修の下、シリーズ30周年を記念する究極のVF-1プラモデルが登場。
description.en: • Under the full supervision of director Masaharu Kawamori, the ultimate VF-1 plastic model has been released to commemorate the 30th episode of the series.

description.ja: • ファイターモード・ガウォークモード・バトロイドモード、３形態完全変形を実現しつつ、各形態のプロポーションを高い次元で両立。
description.en: • Achieves complete transformation in three forms: Fighter mode, Gerwalk mode, and Battroid mode, and balances the proportions of each form at a high level.

description.ja: • 史上初再現となるアクチュエーターの変形を始め、設定に基づいた変形機構を実現。
description.en: • Realizes a deformation mechanism based on the settings, including the deformation of the actuator, which will be reproduced for the first time in history.

description.ja: • ポージングの自由度を高める可動機構も多数採用。
description.en: • Many movable mechanisms are also used to increase the freedom of poses.

description.ja: • 精密に再現されたコクピット用着座姿勢のパイロットフィギュアなど、付属品も充実。
description.en: • A variety of accessories are also available, including a precisely reproduced pilot figure in a sitting position for the cockpit.

description.ja: • マーキングは、カイナスシールと水転写デカールの２種が付属。
description.en: • Two types of markings are included: Kynas Seal and water transfer decal.
